8.6.3 Configurable interfaces
In this chapter all interfaces are listed where the target function could be configured.
The target function is a call-back function implemented by an upper layer module. The
function names contain a tag <Up> that is replaced with the module name abbreviation
of the concrete upper layer module and two configurable infix [SoAd] and [If] or [Tp].
[SWS_SoAd_00538] ⌈For each configurable interface SoAd shall determine the function name by replacing the tag <Up> with the module name abbreviation of the related
upper layer module (as specified in the SoAdBSWModules container using the SoAdBswModuleRef reference parameter) and using the two infix according to the configuration parameters SoAdUseCallerInfix and SoAdUseTypeInfix.⌋
The ServiceID of the functions defined in this chapter are specified at the upper layer
module implementing the functions.

targets.why: Multiple configurable interface definitions in the passage use PduIdType as parameter types.
The passage uses PduInfoType as parameters in several configurable interfaces like RxIndication and TriggerTransmit.
Interfaces such as <Up>_[SoAd][If]TriggerTransmit and <Up>_[SoAd][If]TxConfirmation use Std_ReturnType.
The passage includes the definition of <Up>_[SoAd][Tp]StartOfReception which takes a PduLengthType parameter.
The configurable interface <Up>_[SoAd][Tp]StartOfReception uses BufReq_ReturnType as its return type.
